STEP 2 - Vessel: The vessel is a small white paper plate, roughly 18 cm in diameter. Its area is 3.14 × 9² ≈ 254 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: The only food is whole almonds. I count about 22 of them, and there is no oil or sauce.

STEP 4 - Area: The almonds cover about 20% of the plate, which is roughly 51 cm².

STEP 5 - Volume: 51 cm² × 1.0 cm average height (a single layer with a little overlap) ≈ 51 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: 51 ml × 0.6 bulk density for whole nuts ≈ 31 g. As a cross-check, 22 almonds × about 1.2 g each ≈ 26 g. I settle on about 28 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Almonds provide about 579 kcal per 100 g, so 28 g × 5.79 ≈ 162 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A single 1-oz serving of almonds is about 23 almonds, 28 g and 160 kcal, which matches this estimate well.
